title: Compactifications supplied by a compatible proper/open triangle
statement: Let $X,U,\overline X,Y,\overline Y,Z$ be schemes. Let $a:X\hookrightarrow U$, $b:U\hookrightarrow\overline X$, and $i:Y\hookrightarrow\overline Y$ be open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion], and let $s:U\to Y$, $p:\overline X\to\overline Y$, and $q:\overline Y\to Z$ be proper morphisms [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Suppose the square $pb=is$ is Cartesian, with its specified pullback square [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define three compactifications [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]: $c_f=(a,s)$ of $sa$, with ambient scheme $U$; $c_g=(i,q)$ of $qi$, with ambient scheme $\overline Y$; and $c_{gf}=(ba,qp)$ of $(qi)(sa)$, with ambient scheme $\overline X$. The first two factorization equalities are identities, and the third is induced by the given square. The proper and open fields are inherited from the specified maps and their composites. These are actual compactification records; no further compactification is chosen and no existence or coherence assertion is made.
